content: For each match, considering every innings, please combine runs from both batsman scored and extra runs for each over, then identify the single over with the highest total runs, retrieve the bowler for that over from the ball by ball table, and calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches, ensuring that all runs and bowler details are accurately reflected.

args.sql:
SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) as num_bowlers
FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball
GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) > 1

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs)
FROM ranked_overs
WHERE rn = 1

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
)
SELECT r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs, b.bowler
FROM ranked_overs r
JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b ON r.match_id = b.match_id AND r.innings_no = b.innings_no AND r.over_id = b.over_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
GROUP BY r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs, b.bowler
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) > 1

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,

    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
)
SELECT r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) as num_bowlers
FROM ranked_overs r
JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b ON r.match_id = b.match_id AND r.innings_no = b.innings_no AND r.over_id = b.over_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
GROUP BY r.match_id, r.innings_no, r.over_id, r.total_runs
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) > 1

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs)
FROM ranked_overs
WHERE rn = 1

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
),
highest_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs
    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE rn = 1
),
highest_overs_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, h.total_runs, b.bowler
    FROM highest_overs h
    JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b ON h.match_id = b.match_id AND h.innings_no = b.innings_no AND h.over_id = b.over_id
    GROUP BY h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, h.total_runs, b.bowler
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) FROM highest_overs_with_bowler

SELECT AVG(total_runs)
FROM (
    SELECT 
        t1.match_id, 
        t1.innings_no, 
        t1.over_id, 
        t1.total_runs, 
        b.bowler
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            match_id, 
            innings_no, 
            over_id, 
            SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) DESC) as rn
        FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
        LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
        GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
    ) t1
    JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
    WHERE t1.rn = 1
    GROUP BY t1.match_id, t1.innings_no, t1.over_id, t1.total_runs, b.bowler
)

SELECT 
    match_id, 
    innings_no, 
    over_id, 
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) DESC) as rn
FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
ORDER BY match_id LIMIT 5

args.sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM over_runs
),
highest_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs
    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE rn = 1
),
highest_overs_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, h.total_runs, b.bowler
    FROM highest_overs h
    JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b ON h.match_id = b.match_id AND h.innings_no = b.innings_no AND h.over_id = b.over_id
    GROUP BY h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, h.total_runs, b.bowler
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) FROM highest_overs_with_bowler

        GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
    ) t1
    JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b 
        ON t1.match_id = b.match_id AND t1.innings_no = b.innings_no AND t1.over_id = b.over_id
    WHERE t1.rn = 1
    GROUP BY t1.match_id, t1.total_runs, b.bowler
)
